name: Konndor Industries Limited
about: Konndor Industries Limited engages in the trading and marketing of paper products in India. It operates through the Printing and Stationery, Commodities and Agriculture, and Other segments. The company was formerly known as Arms Paper Limited and changed its name to Konndor Industries Limited in October 2019. Konndor Industries Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
